scope: Response to the corridor and performance review of origin/experiments/gerasimov 5587685

P1_prefetch_off_returns_empty.verdict: confirmed in code and reproduced by the reviewer
P1_prefetch_off_returns_empty.cause: prefetch is a generator; `return iter(iterable)` yielded nothing, so prefetch_depth 0 raised 'No scans processed'
P1_prefetch_off_returns_empty.fix: tunnel_guard/io.py: yield from iterable, and one stop-aware publish helper for item, exception and end marker

evidence.before: exit code 1, ValueError: No scans processed
evidence.after: 30 frames processed with prefetch_depth 0; statuses identical to prefetch_depth 1: {candidate: 1, unresolved_obstacle: 29}

P1_corridor_crop_reclipped.verdict: confirmed as a latent defect, fixed, measured as inactive on the current data
P1_corridor_crop_reclipped.cause: mask keeps |y - offset(x)| < base + |offset(x)|; the kernel re-applies the symmetric |y| < base + max|offset|
P1_corridor_crop_reclipped.fix: tunnel_guard/detector.py: the kernel's limit is read off the masked subset (largest |y| plus one voxel), so it cannot drop a point the mask kept

evidence.geometry_points_per_frame: identical on both recordings and on the arc panel: 0 frames differ (median 43268 roundT_doubleT, 72611 doubleT_obstacle)
evidence.why_it_did_not_bite: the corridor's offset grows monotonically along the frame here, so base + max|offset| was always the looser bound; the defect would bite on a frame whose corridor bends back toward the axis or whose far extent is small

P1_continuation_covariance_incomplete.cause: only the two diagonal terms of the prediction variance were propagated; the one-sided fit has s12 < 0, so the omitted cross term is positive and grows fastest with distance
P1_continuation_covariance_incomplete.fix: geometry.py::_continuation returns the covariance and path() carries the full quadratic form; cpp/kernels.cpp mirrors it with the same summation order and clamps at zero

evidence.backend_equivalence: 20/20 geometry arrays identical, 24/24 kernel checks passed
evidence.decision_effect: one object on doubleT_obstacle moves adjacent -> unresolved (10861 -> 10860 adjacent, 3230 -> 3231 unresolved); roundT_doubleT unchanged; statuses unchanged on both

P1_continuation_covariance_incomplete.stated_limits: overlapping windows, edge-anchor error and model error remain outside this bound, so it is not called calibrated; measured coverage of the propagated sigma is 0.11-0.29 at 50-150 m, which is why the horizon uses the heuristic term

P2_arc_panel_side_case_moved_size.cause: object_on_arc added lateral_m to a half-extent, so the box grew while its centre stayed on the arc
P2_arc_panel_side_case_moved_size.fix: the centre is translated along the local normal and the box keeps its dimensions

corrected_panel.scene: R = 300 m arc, 0.8 x 0.8 x 1.0 m object at 40/60/100/150 m, lateral 0.0 and 0.6 m, three frames each

evidence.superseded: the earlier 12 -> 16 of 24 'object reported' figure came from the mis-placed panel and a candidate-level metric

P2_metric_labels.fix: object_reported relabelled as candidate presence; object_confirmed_intersecting added (the operator-facing decision); union_coverage relabelled as a box-grid measure, not support points

P2_reader_shutdown_race.fix: all puts route through the stop-aware publish helper, so a full queue with a closed consumer can no longer park the producer

accepted_criticisms_not_yet_actioned.estimator_failure_is_not_impossibility: accepted; the far-field section now reads as six strategies that failed here, and names a learned section-conditioned bore offset (teammate's branch: 0.026 m median at 25-40 m, grouped by recording, not wired in) and a prior-pass or survey alignment as avenues this work did not exhaust
accepted_criticisms_not_yet_actioned.horizontal_only: these changes are lateral geometry; the rail-head height bias the reviewer found and a full local_3d check remain unaddressed here
accepted_criticisms_not_yet_actioned.no_universal_speedup: the reviewer's 90-frame runs show this branch slower in median processing on all three recordings and better in wall time per frame on two; consistent with my own numbers, and 10 Hz is not reached
accepted_criticisms_not_yet_actioned.curvature_unvalidated_on_real_turns: the six sourcecraft recordings have almost no measurable curvature; the extended recording (data/new_data, 11271 scans, 22% of frames below 800 m radius) is where this must be tested. tunnel_guard.extended_subset builds one-split subsets for sampling it; the measurement is outstanding

trade_offs_stated: the covariance fix enlarges the corridor's uncertainty, which moves objects to the conservative side (measured: one object on one recording)
the panel's candidate metric is not a hazard metric; the confirmed column is reported alongside it
limiting the kernel by the masked subset makes the voxel grid as wide as the data rather than a fixed base + max|offset|; no extra allocation, and no point loss
no latency claim is made for the prefetch fix: the reader on/off comparison is now runnable but was not run under controlled conditions
not_verified: the crop fix's effect on a frame whose corridor bends back toward the axis (latent case, not present in the current recordings)
curvature continuation accuracy on real sharp curves (extended recording, extended_subset sampler prepared)
any precision or recall claim on real data: there is no exhaustive annotation of the panels or the recordings

measured_pattern_panel_1460_frames.verdict: byte-identical to the pre-fix baseline on every metric; wall time 415 -> 430 s is load

panel_declared_criterion.note: not met before these fixes either; reported as the standing gap, not as a regression
